panels.title: Airing: should the windows be open?
Airing now

targets.rawSql:
WITH rooms AS (SELECT time, sensor, temp_c, humidity_pct FROM indoor WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, sensor, temp_c, humidity_pct FROM channel WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time)),
now_rooms AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(temp_c ORDER BY time) AS t,
  last_value(humidity_pct ORDER BY time) AS rh FROM rooms GROUP BY sensor),
dew AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(dewpoint_c ORDER BY time) AS dp FROM derived
  WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND dewpoint_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sensor),
vent AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room,
  last_value(dewpoint_delta_c ORDER BY time) AS delta,
  last_value(predicted_humidity_pct ORDER BY time) AS predicted FROM ventilation
  WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY sensor)
SELECT v.room AS "Room", r.t AS "Temperature", r.rh AS "Humidity",
  d.dp AS "Dew point", v.delta AS "Above outside",
  v.predicted AS "Humidity after airing", v.predicted - r.rh AS "Change"
FROM vent v JOIN now_rooms r ON r.sensor = v.sensor JOIN dew d ON d.sensor = v.sensor
ORDER BY v.delta DESC

panels.description: For each room: its dew point against the outdoor one, and the humidity it would settle at if its air were replaced with outside air at the room's temperature. Green means airing would dry the room, red that it would add moisture.

panels.title: Dew point above outside

targets.rawSql:
WITH names AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room FROM derived WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY sensor)
SELECT $__dateBin(r.time) AS time, n.room, avg(r.dewpoint_delta_c) AS "Delta"
FROM ventilation r JOIN names n ON n.sensor = r.sensor
WHERE r.station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(r.time)
GROUP BY 1, n.room ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Room dew point minus outdoor dew point. Above the shaded band airing dries the room; below it, airing brings moisture in.

panels.title: House aired

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, avg(CASE WHEN aired THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Aired"
FROM house WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: When the house reads as aired: its rooms' dew points within 1 °C of each other, their median within 0.7 °C of the outdoor one, and their median temperature within 2.5 °C of outdoors. Green where it read so for most of each interval.

panels.title: House against outside

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, avg(dewpoint_spread_c) AS "Rooms' dew points apart",
  avg(dewpoint_delta_c) AS "Dew point above outside",
  avg(temp_delta_c) AS "Temperature above outside"
FROM house WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The measures that decide whether the house is aired, for the rooms' median: how far apart the rooms' dew points are, and how far their dew point and temperature are above outdoors'. All three near zero means the rooms share the outdoor air.

panels.title: Humidity now and after airing

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, avg(humidity_pct) AS "Now", avg(predicted_humidity_pct) AS "After airing"
FROM house WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The rooms' median humidity, and what it would settle at once their air had been replaced by outdoor air and brought back to their temperature. With the house aired the two meet.

panels.title: Temperature above outside

targets.rawSql:
WITH names AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room FROM derived WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY sensor)
SELECT $__dateBin(r.time) AS time, n.room, avg(r.temp_delta_c) AS "Delta"
FROM ventilation r JOIN names n ON n.sensor = r.sensor
WHERE r.station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(r.time)
GROUP BY 1, n.room ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Room temperature minus outdoor temperature. A room aired on its own closes on zero while the others stay where they were.

panels.title: Dew point against the house

targets.rawSql:
WITH names AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room FROM derived WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY sensor)
SELECT $__dateBin(r.time) AS time, n.room, avg(r.house_dewpoint_delta_c) AS "Delta"
FROM ventilation r JOIN names n ON n.sensor = r.sensor
WHERE r.station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(r.time)
GROUP BY 1, n.room ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Room dew point minus the rooms' median. A room with moisture of its own -- a bathroom after a shower, a room aired on its own -- moves away from the others.

panels.title: Humidity

targets.rawSql:
WITH rooms AS (SELECT time, sensor, temp_c, humidity_pct FROM indoor WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, sensor, temp_c, humidity_pct FROM channel WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time)), names AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room FROM derived WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY sensor)

GROUP BY 1, n.room ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Shading marks the usual comfort range of 40-60%; mould becomes likely when a room stays above 70%.

targets.rawSql:

panels.description: Each room's dew point, with the outdoor one dashed. The room whose line sits highest above it gains most from airing.

panels.title: Absolute humidity

targets.rawSql:
WITH names AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room FROM derived WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY sensor)
SELECT $__dateBin(r.time) AS time, n.room, avg(r.abs_humidity_gm3) AS "Absolute humidity"

WHERE r.station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(r.time) AND r.abs_humidity_gm3 IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Water vapour per cubic metre of air. Unlike relative humidity it does not change with temperature, so rooms can be compared directly.

panels.title: Wind direction

targets.rawSql:

panels.title: Temperature: station minus model

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, avg(temp_c) AS v FROM outdoor
  WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1
), m AS (
  SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, avg(temp_c) AS v FROM model
  WHERE station = '${station}' AND model = '${model}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.time, s.v - m.v AS "Station − model"
FROM s JOIN m ON s.time = m.time
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The outdoor temperature minus the weather model's. Within the shaded ±3 °C band is what usually separates one thermometer from a model's grid cell, the bound the status page uses; a lasting excursion beyond it points at the sensor or its siting, such as afternoon sun on the screen.

panels.title: Wind direction: station minus model

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, (degrees(atan2(avg(sin(radians(dir_avg10m_deg))), avg(cos(radians(dir_avg10m_deg))))) + 360) % 360 AS d FROM wind
  WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1
), m AS (
  SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, (degrees(atan2(avg(sin(radians(dir_deg))), avg(cos(radians(dir_deg))))) + 360) % 360 AS d FROM model
  WHERE station = '${station}' AND model = '${model}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1
  HAVING avg(speed_kmh) >= 10.8
)
SELECT s.time, (s.d - m.d + 540) % 360 - 180 AS "Station − model"
FROM s JOIN m ON s.time = m.time
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The station's ten-minute direction minus the weather model's, the short way round, only while the model has at least 10.8 km/h of wind: below that a vane wanders. Within the shaded ±60° band is usual; a steady offset beyond it is a vane pointed wrongly or turned by a building.

panels.title: Temperature and dew point
panels.description: The weather model's forecast for the next 48 hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, temp_c AS "Temperature", dewpoint_c AS "Dew point"
FROM (
  SELECT time, temp_c, dewpoint_c,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY time ORDER BY CAST(lead AS BIGINT)) AS newest
  FROM forecast
  WHERE station = '${station}' AND model = '${model}' AND $__timeFilter(time)
)
WHERE newest = 1 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Rain

FROM (
  SELECT time, precip_1h_mm, precip_probability_pct,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY time ORDER BY CAST(lead AS BIGINT)) AS newest
  FROM forecast
  WHERE station = '${station}' AND model = '${model}' AND $__timeFilter(time)
)
WHERE newest = 1 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Wind
panels.description: Forecast at 10 m, the height the station's own wind is estimated at.

targets.rawSql:

  SELECT time, humidity_pct, cloud_cover_pct,

panels.title: Next 7 days
panels.description: The station's local days, from today, as the weather model forecasts them.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, weather_code AS "Weather", temp_min_c AS "Low", temp_max_c AS "High", precip_mm AS "Rain", precip_probability_pct AS "Chance", humidity_mean_pct AS "Humidity", gust_max_kmh AS "Gusts", uv_index_max AS "UV"
FROM (
  SELECT time, weather_code, temp_min_c, temp_max_c, precip_mm, precip_probability_pct, humidity_mean_pct, gust_max_kmh, uv_index_max,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY time ORDER BY CAST(lead AS BIGINT)) AS newest
  FROM forecast_daily
  WHERE station = '${station}' AND model = '${model}' AND time >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE '${station_tz}')
)
WHERE newest = 1 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Last report

targets.rawSql:
SELECT now() AS time,
  date_part('epoch', now() - max(time)) AS "Age"
FROM station
WHERE station = '${station}' AND time >= now() - interval '7 days'

panels.description: Time since the console's last accepted report.

panels.title: Sensors

targets.rawSql:
WITH names AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room FROM derived WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY sensor),
bat AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(low ORDER BY time) AS low, max(time) AS seen
  FROM battery WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY sensor),
latest AS (SELECT max(seen) AS seen FROM bat),
stale AS (SELECT sensor, last_value(unchanged_s ORDER BY time) AS unchanged
  FROM derived WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND unchanged_s IS NOT NULL
  AND (sensor IN ('indoor', 'outdoor') OR sensor LIKE 'ch%') GROUP BY sensor),
ids AS (SELECT b.sensor FROM bat b CROSS JOIN latest l
  WHERE b.seen >= l.seen - interval '10 minutes'
  UNION SELECT sensor FROM stale)
SELECT CASE WHEN n.room IS NULL OR n.room = i.sensor THEN initcap(i.sensor)
  ELSE n.room END AS "Sensor",
  b.low AS "Battery", s.unchanged AS "Unchanged"
FROM ids i LEFT JOIN names n ON n.sensor = i.sensor
  LEFT JOIN bat b ON b.sensor = i.sensor LEFT JOIN stale s ON s.sensor = i.sensor
ORDER BY s.unchanged DESC NULLS LAST

panels.description: Each sensor's latest low-battery flag, and how long the rooms' and the outdoor sensor's readings have stayed identical. The console repeats a sensor's last value when its radio goes quiet, so a long time unchanged usually means a lost or dead sensor; the Sensor not updating alert fires at 3 hours. Solar, wind and rain are left out, since each can sit unchanged for hours (all night, in a calm, whenever it is dry), and so are sensors that stopped reporting their battery earlier in the range.

panels.title: Pressure calibration

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__dateBin(time) AS time, avg(rel_error_hpa) AS "Console error"
FROM pressure
WHERE station = '${station}' AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The console's relative pressure minus this server's reduction of its absolute reading at the standard atmosphere's temperature. Near zero means the console's altitude setting is right.

panels.title: Interval

targets.rawSql:

ORDER BY time

panels.description: The upload interval set on the console.

panels.title: Station settings
panels.description: The station's settings as the collector last published them to the database: written when it starts and whenever the setup page changes them. The time zone decides where the station's day begins, and is taken from the coordinates unless one was entered.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT * FROM station_info WHERE station = '${station}' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT 1 AS "Order", 'Time zone' AS "Setting", timezone AS "Value" FROM latest
UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Latitude', CAST(latitude_deg AS VARCHAR) FROM latest
UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Longitude', CAST(longitude_deg AS VARCHAR) FROM latest
UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Altitude', CAST(altitude_m AS VARCHAR) || ' m' FROM latest
UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Stored units', units_temperature || ', ' || units_pressure || ', ' || units_rain
  || ', ' || units_wind || ', ' || units_distance FROM latest
UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Weather model', coalesce(weather_model, 'off') FROM latest
UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'Settings changed', CAST(time AS VARCHAR) || ' UTC' FROM latest
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Notifications sent
panels.description: Each notification Grafana sent through a contact point that records them (see the collector's Grafana page), newest first: the house's, and the system's for this server.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time AS "Sent", status AS "Status", rule AS "Rule", rooms AS "Rooms", message AS "Message"
FROM notification
WHERE (station = '${station}' OR station IS NULL) AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time DESC
